Bright yellow-white reaction areas and orange filaments surround dark structural patches and internal flame gaps.
A large opaque black smoke plume has rolling lobes and extends sideways beyond the luminous fire, rather than forming a uniform translucent vertical stamp.
This still does not establish flame velocity, burn rate, temperature, timing or a wind simulation; it does not authorize new roof heat or collapse gameplay.
